# Sundial — the 4-player partnership card game

> Sundial (formerly Partnership Trump) is a free, browser-based four-player partnership trick-taking card game. Two teams of two play thirteen tricks with a standard 52-card deck; the team that takes 7 or more tricks wins the round. Play solo against bots, hot-seat with friends on one device, or host a room to play across devices.

## Game rules

- Four players, two teams of two. Partners sit opposite each other; you never see your partner's hand.
- Ace is high, 2 is low. The trump suit beats every other suit, even a 2 trumping an Ace.
- Player 1 names the trump suit from their first five cards.
- The dealer leads the first trick; the winner of each trick leads the next.
- Players must follow suit if they hold a card of the led suit; otherwise they may play any card, including trump.
- Play all 13 tricks. The deal rotates left after each round.

## How to play

- Solo: play against 3 bots, or choose which seats are human for hot-seat play.
- Start a game: host a room and share the invite link or room code.
- Join a game: open the invite link or type the room code, then choose your seat.
